title: Pokemon TCG Lacey 172/142 Stellar Crown Secret Double Rare
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText: The 2024 Stellar Crown Secret Double Rare Lacey 172/142 Pokemon card is a speciality Trainer card from the Pokémon TCG set. Illustrated by Souichirou Gunjima, this Full Art card features the character Lacey with a holo finish. As a Supporter card with a high HP, it is designed for players aged 6 and above to add to their collection of CCG individual cards. Manufactured by Nintendo, this rare card is a prized possession for fans of the Pokémon franchise.
